title: Avoid Ineffective Study Methods
summary: Дахин унших, тодруулах нь шалгалтад бэлдэх хамгийн сайн арга биш гэдгийг тайлбарлана.

source.name: VOA Learning English
source.creditLine: John Russell wrote this story for Learning English. George Grow was the editor.

changes: Headings, sign-off, credit line, the closing call for comments and the Words in This Story list removed.

questions.prompt: What does Mary Pyc say about rereading and highlighting?
options: They are not the best ways to study
They are the best ways to study
They are worse than not studying
questions.explain: Пайк "both rereading and highlighting are ineffective study tools" гэсэн. Гэхдээ огт хичээл давтахгүй байснаас дээр.

questions.prompt: Which way to study does the text suggest?
questions.explain: "One idea is to test yourself" гэж бичсэн. Флаш карт, туршилтын шалгалт тусалдаг.

questions.prompt: Why does rereading give students a false feeling?
options: The text feels familiar, so they think they know it
The book is too difficult for them to understand
They read too slowly to finish the whole book
questions.explain: Дахин уншихад "it is going to feel like you already know the information" буюу мэддэг юм шиг санагддаг.
